\chapter{From a structural diagram to Akeyless configuration}\label{doc-path-and-role-design}}

\hypertarget{method-always-produce-these-five-artifacts}{%
\section{Method (always produce these five artifacts)}\label{method-always-produce-these-five-artifacts}}

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Inventory} from the diagram: tenants/BUs, applications, environments, data classes
  (PCI, break-glass), personas (workload, dev team, platform admin, auditor, SecOps,
  certificate requester) and the identity source of each persona.
\item
  \textbf{Path tree} for items.
\item
  \textbf{Access matrix}: personas x path scopes -\textgreater{} capabilities (+ rule type).
\item
  \textbf{YAML model diff} (\texttt{terraform/model/...}) and \textbf{access expectations}
  (\texttt{access\_expectations.yaml}).
\item
  \textbf{Plan expectations} and the equivalent \textbf{CLI} for break-glass/bootstrap.
\end{enumerate}

Ask before guessing when the diagram does not say who the identity source is, how environments are
segregated, who may change RBAC, or who owns break-glass.

\hypertarget{path-rules}{%
\section{Path rules}\label{path-rules}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Delegation boundary first, then the dimensions you grant on, most specific last:
  \texttt{/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/\textless{}app\textgreater{}/\textless{}env\textgreater{}/\textless{}class\textgreater{}/\textless{}secret\textgreater{}}, e.g. \texttt{/payments/checkout/prod/db/orders-ro}.
\item
  If environment is the primary security boundary (separate prod operators):
  \texttt{/\textless{}env\textgreater{}/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/\textless{}app\textgreater{}/...}. Cross-cut the other dimension with \texttt{+} (\texttt{/payments/+/prod/*}).
\item
  Reserve top-level namespaces: \texttt{/shared}, \texttt{/pki/\{ca,issuers,certs\}}, \texttt{/platform}.
\item
  Only auditors (list) and admins get \texttt{/*}; the guards enforce it (\texttt{allow\_root\_scope}).
\item
  Stable identifiers only (app IDs, not team or person names): renames destroy and recreate
  objects in Terraform and break consumer paths.
\item
  Carve-outs (\texttt{break-glass}, \texttt{pci}) as a fixed segment so one \texttt{deny} covers them.
\end{itemize}

\texttt{\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/\textless{}app\textgreater{}-\textless{}env\textgreater{}-workload} & item read,list on \texttt{/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/\textless{}app\textgreater{}/\textless{}env\textgreater{}/*}; deny on carve-outs & cloud/K8s auth method bound to the workload \\
\texttt{\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/team-admin} & item CRUD on nonprod, read,list on prod, deny carve-outs & SSO + \texttt{groups=\textless{}idp-group\textgreater{}} \\
\texttt{\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/delegated-admin} (optional) & item CRUD on \texttt{/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/*}; target CRUD on \texttt{/targets/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/*} & SSO group; RBAC changes stay in the pipeline \\
\texttt{platform/auditors} & item list \texttt{/*}; role/auth-method read,list \texttt{/*}; \texttt{audit\_access=all} & SSO group \\
\texttt{platform/pki-requesters-\textless{}x\textgreater{}} & rule on the issuer + its \texttt{destination\_path} & workload or SSO \\
\texttt{platform/breakglass} & admin-equivalent & MFA SSO group, alert on use \\
\end{longtable}

\textbf{Admin plane:} only the pipeline identity holds create/update/delete on \texttt{role-rule} and
\texttt{auth-method-rule}. Humans get read,list on those plus \texttt{audit\_access}.

\hypertarget{worked-example}{%
\section{Worked example}\label{worked-example}}

Diagram: \emph{"Payments BU owns apps checkout and refunds, each with prod and nonprod. Payments engineers
(Entra group grp-akl-payments-admins) manage nonprod and read prod. Checkout prod pods (namespace
payments, SA payments-api) and the checkout Lambda role (payments-app, account 123456789012) read
checkout prod. Nobody but break-glass may read prod/break-glass. Auditors see everything but no
values."}

Path tree:

\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere,frame=leftline,framerule=1.2pt,rulecolor=\color{wo-rule},xleftmargin=6pt]
/payments/checkout/{prod,nonprod}/...
/payments/refunds/{prod,nonprod}/...
/payments/+/prod/break-glass/...   (carve-out)
\end{Verbatim}
